description: Environments of a project, such as `staging` and `production`, in `jevision.environments.json` in the project folder: named sets of values that tests read as `${env.NAME}`, like the address of a server. Secrets never go here; tests read them as `${secret.NAME}`.

default.description: The environment a run uses when none is chosen; one of `environments`.

environments.description: Every environment by its name, of letters, digits, `-` and `_`. Each holds its values by name, which tests read as `${env.NAME}`.

format.description: Version of the layout of the file. JEVision doesn't open a file in a format newer than it knows.

title: JEVision environments
